stem: Which statement correctly completes this time line?

options.label: A
options.text: The Centers for Disease Control petitioned Congress to eliminate waste treatment plants.

options.label: B
options.text: The federal government created the Environmental Protection Agency to oversee environmental issues.

options.label: C
options.text: The automobile industry began researching alternative energy sources.

options.label: D
options.text: The president ordered the Public Health Service to deal with environmental pollution.

visual_elements: Timeline: 1962 - In her book Silent Spring, Rachel Carson warned the public of the consequences of widespread pesticide use.
1970 - Twenty million Americans celebrated the first Earth Day. ?
The Clean Air Act was passed, regulating air emissions from all sources.
1972 - The Clean Water Act was passed, regulating the quality of surface waters.
1973 - The Endangered Species Act was passed, protecting threatened wildlife.
